Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring an applicant for a food and beverage service worker's permit to provide documentation of a negative tuberculosis test.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a food and beverage service worker's permit; andamending RCW 69.06.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.06.030 and 1998 c 136 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An applicant for a food and beverage service worker's permitunder RCW 69.06.010 must submit documentation, in a format approved bythe state board of health, that the applicant has tested negative fortuberculosis within twenty working days prior to the issuance of thepermit. The state board of health may establish testing requirementsfor permit applicants for other infectious diseases that may threatenthe public health at food service establishments. (2) It shall be unlawful for any person afflicted with anycontagious or infectious disease that may be transmitted by food orbeverage to work in or about any place where unwrapped or unpackagedfood and/or beverage products are prepared or sold, or offered for salefor human consumption and it shall be unlawful for any person knowinglyto employ a person so afflicted. Nothing in this section eliminates p. 1 HB 2803any authority or requirement to control or suppress communicablediseases pursuant to chapter 70.05 RCW and RCW 43.20.050(2)(e).
